info.description: Local API for DDColor Photo Colorization: bulk-ingest black-and-white scans to Backblaze B2, colorize them in batches with DDColor running locally, and serve originals, colorized outputs, comparisons and per-run manifests from B2. This contract documents the sample's local API, not a hosted public endpoint.
info.title: DDColor Photo Colorization API

schema.title: Response List Batches Endpoint Batches Get

delete.description:
Delete the batch's colorized outputs, comparisons, manifest and record.

Grayscale originals are never deleted.

post.description: Queue a batch for colorization (503 with the install command if DDColor is missing).

schema.title: Response List Files Endpoint Files Get

get.description:
Rich metadata (checksums, image/PDF fields) recomputed on demand.

Unlike /metadata (a cheap head_object), this downloads the object to
re-run extraction, so it is billed at the tighter 'write' rate-limit tier
(see runtime/ratelimit.py) to bound egress/cost amplification.
get.summary: Get File Detail By Key Endpoint

get.description: Return a presigned URL for inline preview. Does not count as a download.

schema.title: Response Upload Activity Endpoint Files Stats Activity Get

get.description: Return a presigned URL for inline preview. Does not count as a download.

post.description:
Validate a declared upload and hand back a presigned PUT.

The browser uploads the bytes straight to B2 with the returned URL, so they
never traverse this Function — that is what lifts Vercel's ~4.5 MB payload
ceiling. Size and content-type are signed into the URL (see the service).
Confirm an object just uploaded directly to B2 is valid and visible.
